name: Re-solve the schedule after changing loads

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Note the scheduled bill total shown in the Outcome panel, and the number of loads listed under Loads.
Click the 'Re-solve' button and wait for the app to finish.

Verify the scheduled bill total is EXACTLY what it was before the press. This app is deterministic: the same scenario must produce the same answer, so a figure that changed here would be the defect. Do not expect the numbers to change.
Click '+ Add a load' and wait for the app to finish re-solving.
Verify the number of loads shown under Loads has increased by exactly one.
Verify the scheduled bill total HAS changed, because the scenario changed. Adding a load changes the answer; re-solving it does not.
